notes_for_us: Grass, rocks and trees are asked for constantly and no option in the system holds them. terrain-relief is landform, settlement-density is buildings, water-body is water - vegetation and ground scatter fall between all three and shipped as free text with no route.

Everything about scale in layout-intake is calibrated to a 16-studs-per-second avatar. The player here is a T-Rex, so 'small and compact' means something several times larger, and the four bands give no way to say the unit of measure changed.

The prompt spends most of its words on mesh generation, rigging and animation, which triage sends to mechanics correctly. But it also states a build order - mesh first, environment fifth - and that is an instruction about how the work is sequenced, which neither notes nor mechanics is really addressed to.

social-hub had to be kept per the take-the-whole-preset rule while being the one option a single-player MVP most obviously excludes. Keeping it and rewriting its text into 'an open clearing' may be worse than dropping it, because the words that reach the image model are now doing something the option was not for.
